author: packs
description: Financial services (X3-T1) for banks, finance companies and Takaful: clients on the CRM account and contact, financial accounts read from core banking (a reference, never posted), KYC onboarding with identity verification, registry check, sanctions result, risk rating and periodic review; financing applications through intake, credit review, approval, offer, disbursement or decline, with Islamic structures; credit reviews decided by a person; regulated complaints with regulator deadlines; a relationship manager book. Card numbers are masked. Roles, report queries and a sidebar.
name: financial-services

definition.description: Owns a book of clients and their applications.
definition.name: Relationship Manager

definition.description: Reviews financing applications; a person decides.
definition.name: Credit Analyst

definition.description: Owns KYC, sanctions results and regulated complaints.
definition.name: Compliance Officer

definition.description: Handles regulated complaints within regulator deadlines.
definition.name: Complaints Officer

definition.description: Reads everything in the branch and approves within limits.
definition.name: Branch Manager
Financial Services: Pipeline by Stage
definition.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS applications, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM fs_financing_application WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

definition.name: Financial Services: KYC Reviews Due
definition.sql: SELECT id, account_ref, risk_rating, next_review_on FROM fs_kyc_profile WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND next_review_on < NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY next_review_on

definition.name: Financial Services: Complaints Near Regulator Deadline
definition.sql: SELECT id, reference, regulator, regulator_deadline FROM fs_complaint WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND outcome = 'open' AND regulator_deadline < NOW() + INTERVAL '5 days' ORDER BY regulator_deadline

target.query: Financial Services: Complaints Near Regulator Deadline

title: Pack: financial services
